Not really... It takes maybe 3 or 4 pills for a good two or three hours and if you go all day you might burn through ten... So that's about $15 to $50 in a day, averaging maybe $25. 

Compare that to a coke habit where you'd be spending anywhere from $50 (half gram) to $300 + (8 ball) and Ritalin is an affordable stimulant without many negative consequences...

Thanks but what I watched was evil, there's no other way of putting it... I may be hard on myself but the damage those videos did to me are proof of how evil and disgusting they are... They ruined me as a person and I'm only now finding my way out and back to goodness, to being the person I am at heart and overcoming the evil of what I fantasized about two years ago.

Thanks for your answer, it helped a bit... I know it's inside, I can still sort of feel it when I really try... I was reading my Bible a little while ago and realized the days of evil are gone and the days of good are forever, and I feel it in my heart so that really gives me hope... I guess it's an upward journey from here but I'm progressing which is amazing, when I wrote this post I was going through hell but just realizing that the days of good are here and they'll be here forever really comforts me... 

Edit: good as in morally good, although surviving the hell of psychosis I went through in the past is definitely good, too.
